DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Myeloid Leukemia (CML) with secondary iron deficiency.

The presence of a chromosome 9 mutation (likely the Philadelphia chromosome t(9;22)), thrombocytosis with abnormal platelets, and dysplastic megakaryocytes confirms a myeloproliferative neoplasm. The low iron studies indicate iron deficiency, which is common due to the high cell turnover in leukemia. Given the confirmed genetic marker, we can proceed to confirm the specific type and staging of your leukemia.
